title: UVFR Pit Telemetry (SIMULATED)
description: GENERATED by scripts/generate_dashboard.py from config/dashboard.yaml, config/alerts.yaml and config/channels.yaml. Do not edit by hand. All CAN data shown is SIMULATED in Phase 0.

target.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alert" and r.car == "${car}" and r._field == "message")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "rule"])

panels.title: Vehicle status
panels.description: Worst status over every vehicle channel, including active alarms.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -10s)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "alerts_active" and r.car == "${car}" and r._field == "vehicle_status_code")
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
